rep_perk_LLREFERAL_desc: {0}% chance that {1} additional random customer will visit the Store per day.
rep_perk_LLREFERAL_flavor: Word travels fast in the Lower Levels. A satisfied customer is more than just a sale, they're your best advertisement.
rep_perk_LLTIPS_desc: You will occasionally receive tips from the Lower Levels about upcoming events.
rep_perk_LLTIPS_flavor: The people of the Lower Levels have their ears to the ground. If they trust you, they'll keep you in the loop, too.
rep_perk_LLRAREGOOD_desc: New types of customers offering Rare or Contraband goods will start to visit your Store.
rep_perk_LLRAREGOOD_flavor: With the right connections, even the Lower Levels can offer up something worth your while.
rep_perk_LLTIGHTLIPS_desc: Selling Contraband to customers from the Lower Levels will only create {0:P0} of its value in available evidence.
rep_perk_LLTIGHTLIPS_flavor: You've earned their trust. They know you're good for it, and they're not going to rat you out.
rep_perk_LLPILLAR_desc: You will now receive {0}% discount from Joe Wild and Dr. Jackson.
rep_perk_LLPILLAR_flavor: You've earned the respect of the Lower Levels. Even other Lower Levels leaders recognize the good you do.
rep_perk_LLPOORREVIEWS_desc: {0}% chance that {1} less random customer will visit your Store per day.
rep_perk_LLPOORREVIEWS_flavor: All it takes is a few dissatisfied customers, and your Reputation in the Lower Levels takes a hit.
rep_perk_LLDISTRUSTED_desc: Customers from the Lower Levels will no longer sell you Contraband items.
rep_perk_LLDISTRUSTED_flavor: You are known throughout the Lower Levels as a liability. Those with contraband to sell will take it elsewhere.
rep_perk_LLTARGET_desc: You will be targeted more frequently by thieves. Insurance will now cost {0}x.
rep_perk_LLTARGET_flavor: Your poor reputation has put a target on your back. The Lower Levels never forget.
rep_perk_LLAVOIDED_desc: All suppliers will refuse to take your calls. Dr. Jackson will no longer visit your Store, except under special circumstances.
rep_perk_LLAVOIDED_flavor: No one want to associate with you anymore. Fearing for their own reputation.
rep_perk_LLLYNCH_desc: A mob from the Lower Levels will attack your Store and lynch you.
rep_perk_LLLYNCH_flavor: The people of the Lower Levels have had enough, they'll take matters into their own hands.
rep_perk_SEC_REQUISITION_desc: A Security Requisition Officer will occasionally visit your Store to purchase Food and Medical Supplies. Trading with them will increase your Reputation.
rep_perk_SEC_REQUISITION_flavor: Even Station Security has to get their supplies from someone. They will pay you a fair price.
rep_perk_SEC_ALARM_IGNORED_desc: Security will not longer respond to your alarms.
rep_perk_SEC_ALARM_IGNORED_flavor: You've cried wolf one too many times, or maybe you're just not worth the trouble anymore. Either way, when things go south, you're on your own.
rep_perk_SEC_WATCHLIST_desc: Security has added you on their watchlist. Any investigation on you will progress x{0} times faster.
rep_perk_SEC_WATCHLIST_flavor: Your notoriety has caught the eye of Station Security. Keep your head down, or lose it.
rep_perk_SEC_PRIORITY_desc: Any investigation on you will progress x{0} times faster.
rep_perk_SEC_PRIORITY_flavor: Another day, another case file with your name on it on the desk of the Head of Station Security...
rep_perk_SEC_THOROUGH_INSPECTION_desc: Security will no longer sent you lazy or shady inspectors. Additionally, inspections will be more frequent.
rep_perk_SEC_THOROUGH_INSPECTION_flavor: No more easy passes or conveniently blind inspectors. Every visit is now a full sweep.
rep_perk_SEC_CONTRABAND_TOLERANCE_desc: Security will prosecute you to the maximum extent of the law regarding contraband found during inspection.
rep_perk_SEC_CONTRABAND_TOLERANCE_flavor: No more warnings. No more bribes. Even the smallest contraband could land you in serious trouble.
rep_perk_SEC_IMMEDIATE_ARREST_desc: Security will immediately arrest and jail you, regardless of any evidence they have (or don't have).
rep_perk_SEC_IMMEDIATE_ARREST_flavor: When they want you gone, the truth doesn't matter. They'll make sure the "evidence" says exactly what they need it to.
rep_perk_SEC_PROTECTION_desc: Due to your good Reputation with Security, Thieves are more reluctant to target your Store.
rep_perk_SEC_PROTECTION_flavor: Having the eyes of Station Security on you isn't always a bad thing.
rep_perk_SEC_SURPLUS_desc: A Security Surplus Merchant will occasionally visit the Store.
rep_perk_SEC_SURPLUS_flavor: Station Security has agreed to sell you their decommissioned equipment, including weapons and armor.
rep_perk_SEC_RELIABLE_VENDOR_desc: The Security Surplus Merchant will have improved wares, and Security customers will have {0}% more credits to spend.
rep_perk_SEC_RELIABLE_VENDOR_flavor: You've proven yourself to be a reliable vendor. Station Security is willing to do more business with you.
rep_perk_SEC_VIP_desc: Due to your excellent Reputation with Security, Thieves will no longer target your Store. You will no longer be subject to inspection.
rep_perk_SEC_VIP_flavor: You're untouchable. Security has your back, and they're not going to let anyone mess with you.
rep_perk_SEC_TRUSTED_desc: Inspections will be less frequent, and any investigations will progress slower. You will receive advanced warning of any impending Security Operation.
rep_perk_SEC_TRUSTED_flavor: Being trusted means less hassle from Security. Inspections are now few and far between.
rep_perk_BM_NETWORK_desc: You will receive advanced notice of most Black Market events.
rep_perk_BM_NETWORK_flavor: It's who you know that matters.
rep_perk_BM_DISTRUSTED_desc: Customers from the Black Market will no longer sell you Contraband items. You are barred from the Underground Exchange. The Janitorial Service cost double.
rep_perk_BM_DISTRUSTED_flavor: Your credits aren't worth a thing if nobody trusts you enough to sell.
rep_perk_BM_UNINSURABLE_desc: Insurance services will not longer be available to you.
rep_perk_BM_UNINSURABLE_flavor: Due to your infamy with the Black Market, even Joe Wild can't insure you anymore. You're on your own now.
rep_perk_BM_SMALL_TIME_BROKER_desc: Petty Thieves have an increased chance of visiting your Store. Their wares will now improve with higher Black Market Reputation.
rep_perk_BM_SMALL_TIME_BROKER_flavor: You are starting to build a reputation with the Black Market.
rep_perk_BM_HONOR_desc: Reputation is lost with the Black Market at a rate of x{0}, regardless of your current Reputation.
rep_perk_BM_RELIABLE_desc: You are guaranteed a visit from a Thief once per week. All thieves will now offer improved wares.
rep_perk_BM_RELIABLE_flavor: The Thieves of the Black Market know you're good for it, and more are willing to deal with you.
rep_perk_UL_GOSSIP_desc: You will receive advanced notice of most Upper Levels events.
rep_perk_UL_GOSSIP_flavor: They never stop talking up there... sometimes they even say something useful.
rep_perk_UL_TIPS_desc: You will receive {0}% bonus when selling items to customers from the Upper Levels.
rep_perk_UL_TIPS_flavor: They don't haggle. They just drop a few extra credits and call it etiquette.
rep_perk_UL_CHARITY_desc: A benefactor from the Upper Levels will occasionally donate goods to your Store.
rep_perk_UL_CHARITY_flavor: Publicity stunts or genuine kindness? You won't argue with free goods.
rep_perk_UL_HOUSEHOLD_NAME_desc: You have {0}% chance of receiving {1} additional daily customer from the Upper Levels.
rep_perk_UL_HOUSEHOLD_NAME_flavor: Your Store has become the talk of the Upper Levels.
rep_perk_UL_TOP_REVIEW_desc: All customers from the Upper Levels have {0}% more credits to spend.
rep_perk_UL_TOP_REVIEW_flavor: Your Store is the worst kept secret in the Upper Levels. Customers from the Upper Levels are willing to spend more when they visit.
rep_perk_UL_TOURISTTRAP_desc: Customers from the Upper Levels are less likely to visit your Store.
rep_perk_UL_TOURISTTRAP_flavor: Upper Levels clients expect better. Lately, you're not delivering.
rep_perk_UL_PETITION_desc: You lose Reputation with Security {0}x faster and active investigations progress {1:P0} faster.
rep_perk_UL_PETITION_flavor: Using their influence, the Upper Levels have petitioned Security to keep a closer eye on you.
rep_perk_UL_HITMAN_desc: A hit will be immediately placed on you by the Upper Levels.
rep_perk_UL_HITMAN_flavor: A contract has been signed in a luxury suites above. You've made the wrong enemies.
rep_perk_REV_FRIEND_desc: You will receive advanced notice of most Revolution events.
rep_perk_REV_FRIEND_flavor: The revolution will make sure you are not caught in the crossfire.
rep_perk_REV_HIT_desc: A revolution hit squad will be immediately tasked with eliminating you.
rep_perk_REV_HIT_flavor: You have been declared an enemy of the revolution. They will stop at nothing to see you gone.
rep_perk_REV_BLACKLISTED_desc: Customers sympathetic to the Revolution are less likely to visit your Store.
rep_perk_REV_BLACKLISTED_flavor: Notice has been circulated among revolutionary cells, warning members to avoid doing business with you.
rep_perk_REV_REQUEST_desc: You will occasionally receive Marketplace Requests from various Revolution cells.
rep_perk_REV_REQUEST_flavor: From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.
rep_perk_REV_RAID_LOOT_desc: Members of the Revolution will occasionally visit to sell off their loot from raids. Prices will improve with higher Reputation.
rep_perk_REV_RAID_LOOT_flavor: The liberation of people requires the liberation of supplies.
rep_perk_REV_QUARTERMASTER_desc: A Revolution Quartermaster will occasionally visit your Store to sell Materials at a discount. The discount will improve with higher Reputation.
rep_perk_REV_QUARTERMASTER_flavor: Revolutions can't run on ideals alone. The Quartermaster sells cheap stock to quietly fund the next move.
rep_perk_CARTEL_RETIRED_desc: A Cartel Hitman has been dispatched to eliminate you.
rep_perk_CARTEL_RETIRED_flavor: Sometimes what is best for the dog is to put it down.
rep_perk_CARTEL_INCREASED_STIPEND_desc: Your weekly stipend now scales with your Cartel Reputation.
rep_perk_CARTEL_INCREASED_STIPEND_flavor: Don't mistake it for kindness, it's an investment.
rep_perk_CARTEL_RELIABLE_CHEMIST_desc: Requesting additional Materials now costs {0}% of the usual Reputation.
rep_perk_CARTEL_RELIABLE_CHEMIST_flavor: The Cartel will reward consistency, and service.
rep_perk_CARTEL_AUTHORIZED_EXIT_desc: Your handler will start to process your authorized exit from the Cartel.
rep_perk_CARTEL_AUTHORIZED_EXIT_flavor: You're lucky, not many get to leave without a body bag...
rep_perk_UL_DISCERNING_TASTE_desc: While a Luxury Item is in your display case, you have {0}% chance each day of receiving an additional customer looking to buy Luxury Items. Rises with Reputation. This customer can only visit once every {1} days.
rep_perk_UL_DISCERNING_TASTE_flavor: Something expensive in a Lower Levels window? The Upper Levels will come down just to say they found it first.
